about.nameBody: Trip + Plan. One word for the whole journey — from the first idea to the last evening.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Quick answers about planning, accounts, payments, languages and privacy.

planning.q1: What's the difference between Fast Trip and Detailed Trip?
planning.a1: Fast Trip asks only the essentials and creates a first itinerary in moments. Detailed Trip lets you set budgets, accommodation, food needs, daily rhythm and walking preferences across seven short steps. Both can be edited afterwards.
planning.q2: How does Triplan build an itinerary?
planning.a2: Triplan groups places that are close together on the same day, orders them to keep travel short, and adds breakfast, lunch, a coffee break and dinner near your stops. If AI is enabled, it drafts the plan using only places from our database.
planning.a3: Yes. Drag stops to reorder, remove or add stops, swap an attraction, lock what you want to keep, and regenerate a single day or the whole trip. Locked stops are never changed without your permission.

accounts.q1: Why do I need an account to plan?
accounts.a1: Your trips are saved to your account so you can open them on any device. Anything you entered before signing in is kept.
accounts.q2: I forgot my password. What can I do?
accounts.a2: Use “Forgot your password?” on the log-in page and we'll email you a secure link that's valid for one hour.

savedTrips.a1: In our secure database, linked to your account — not just in your browser. Only you can see your trips.
savedTrips.q2: Can I duplicate or delete a trip?
savedTrips.a2: Yes, from the trip page. Duplicating is useful for trying a variation without losing the original.

payments.a1: Every account includes one free trip plan. You can buy an additional trip or choose the Annual plan for unlimited trips.
payments.a2: By Stripe, a leading payment provider. Triplan never sees or stores your full card details.
payments.a3: Only the Annual plan renews automatically, and you can cancel any time. Single trips are one-off payments.

languages.a1: English, Arabic, French, Spanish, Italian, Simplified Chinese, Russian and Portuguese. Arabic uses a full right-to-left layout.
languages.q2: Will changing language lose my trip?
languages.a2: No. Your trips are saved in your account and planner forms keep your input when you switch language.

maps.a1: Times are labelled “approx.” when they're estimated from distance. When a routing service is configured, real durations are shown instead.
maps.a2: Triplan shows your stops on an interactive map and hands off to Google Maps for turn-by-turn navigation.

bookings.q1: Can I book hotels and flights on Triplan?
bookings.a1: Triplan links you to trusted providers such as Booking.com, Airbnb, Google Flights and Skyscanner. Bookings and payments happen on their sites.
bookings.q2: Why don't you show prices or availability?
bookings.a2: We only display information we can verify. Live prices and availability are shown by each provider.

subscriptions.q1: What's included in the Annual plan?
subscriptions.a1: Unlimited trip plans for 12 months (fair use) with all planning features.
subscriptions.a2: Go to Profile → Subscription → Manage subscription. Your access continues until the end of the paid period.

privacy.a1: Your account details, the trips you create and anything you post. See the Privacy policy for full details.
privacy.a2: Yes. You can download your data or permanently delete your account from your profile at any time.
